text: Apple HomeView Won't Be Available in the European Union Tuesday October 13, 2026 6:09 am PDT by Hartley Charlton Apple's new HomeView smart home hub will not be available in the European Union because Siri AI is currently unavailable on iOS in the region, the company said today. Apple said it is "working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward," but provided no timeline for EU availability. It costs $299 in the U.S. and launches on November 13 in eight countries around the world. Note: This discussion thread is located in our Political News forum with special rules . [ 12 comments ]
